title: Ranking experimental may be read as investment advice
user_impact: User could over-trust a research prioritization score.
mitigation: Repeated no-advice disclaimers, read-only UI and no broker workflow.
next_action: Keep disclaimers visible through v2.38CH audit.

title: 270 assets blocked by low real factor coverage
user_impact: Some assets cannot be ranked and may disappoint coverage expectations.
mitigation: Blocked population remains visible and excluded from main ranking.
next_action: Prioritize coverage work only after release candidate closure.

title: 26 assets have no scoring adapter
next_action: Create adapters in a later authorized phase.

title: 124 assets require manual or special-model review
user_impact: Financial institutions and outlier margins may be misunderstood.
next_action: Keep separate until a sector-specific contract exists.

title: No real browser screenshots in v2.38CF environment
user_impact: Visual regressions may remain unseen in this execution environment.
mitigation: Structural smoke test is explicit and screenshots_available=false.
next_action: Run real browser smoke test in Windows or a browser-enabled environment.

title: Manifest-based package without heavy ZIP
user_impact: User must reproduce package through repo checkout and manifest rather than a single archive.
mitigation: Manifest lists included/excluded files and hashes.
next_action: Evaluate ZIP only if final publication needs it.

title: Windows local environment dependency drift
user_impact: Different Python/dependency versions can affect local startup.
mitigation: Requirements, launcher and preflight checklist are documented.
next_action: Verify on the user's Windows machine during v2.38CH.

title: Cboe Europe mass identity expansion deferred
user_impact: European coverage remains lower than it could be.
mitigation: Explicit scope-decision limitation; not blocking local release.

title: UK official source automation blocked
user_impact: UK fundamentals coverage cannot be safely automated now.
next_action: Do not bypass access restrictions; revisit with safe source path.

title: Offshore or low-disclosure sources remain incomplete
user_impact: Some jurisdictions remain identity-only or no-disclosure.
mitigation: Limitations are visible and separated from ranked universe.
next_action: Keep as limitation unless new public sources are authorized.

title: Current scoring method lacks predictive validation claim
user_impact: Score could be mistaken for a proven predictor.
mitigation: Product copy says research ranking, not prediction.
next_action: Reconfirm language during release candidate audit.

title: Legal/compliance no-advice boundary must remain intact
user_impact: Bad wording could imply advice, suitability or recommendation.
mitigation: No buy/sell/hold language, no broker actions, no price targets.
next_action: Audit public docs before final publication.

title: UX exposes multiple separated populations
mitigation: Tabs, labels and guide explain each population.
next_action: Validate with real visual smoke test.

title: Product is still local release candidate, not final publication
user_impact: Users may assume the project is final.
next_action: Do not call final until CJ.
